narration: On the first of July, nineteen forty six,

narration: Start with the place. Bikini Atoll, in the Marshall Islands,

narration: On the twenty eighth of May, she had sailed into the lagoon with a crew of four hundred and three.

narration: Pearl Harbor. The seventh of December, nineteen forty one.

narration: battleships, most of them moored in pairs.
shows: Battleship Row close (pearl_row): battleship icons in pairs along Ford Island's east side on 'pairs'

narration: off the frozen island of Attu, in the Aleutians.
